verdict.rationale: Datalab's API and SDK cover the core processing features also offered in the Forge UI: conversion, structured extraction, segmentation, form filling, track-changes DOCX creation, pipelines, file management, agent processors and schema generation. However, nothing documents full UI parity, and account controls such as two-factor authentication are described only as dashboard actions; the OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account, team and security settings (e.g. 2FA, team policies), a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
Segment a document into sections using a schema. Returns page ranges for each identified segment.
The form filling API lets you programmatically fill forms in PDFs and images.
Create a DOCX document from markdown with track changes support.
Run a published agent processor on a document.
For a given file, generate potential extraction schemas.
